purpose: Teach: 花屋/満腹/ひく/きのこ/けんか/人参/レタス/貰える

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新しい花屋、本気で、絶対、葵で、特集してもいいかも、メイちゃん、本気で、感心
lines.en: Aoi, that new florist you found—I'm genuinely impressed. You should totally do a feature on it.
lines.style: Bright and warm opening. Leans forward with genuine admiration. Light, conversational pace. A touch of playful encouragement on the suggestion.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。新作のパフェ、本気で、絶対、満腹に、絶対、なっちゃう、メイちゃん、葵で、絶対、味わってみて、本気で、絶対、本気、絶対。
lines.en: Yeah? You should really try the new parfait. It's absolutely decadent—you'll be so full you won't know what hit you.
lines.style: Cheerful but genuine. Voice brightens on the parfait. Enthusiastic without being performative. A warm invitation, not a hard sell.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 最近、本気で、絶対、風邪を、絶対、ひくこと、ないよう、絶対、葵、手洗い、徹底してるわよね、メイちゃん、感心、本気、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: You know, lately I've really noticed how careful you are with things like handwashing. It's thoughtful of you.
lines.style: Gentle and observant. Softer tone, slower pace. Noticing something quiet about her. Warm admiration that doesn't demand a response.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お料理に、本気で、絶対、きのこ、絶対、ふんだんに、絶対、使うことに、メイちゃん、本気で、本気、絶対、葵で、絶対、感謝、本気、絶対。
lines.en: I'm genuinely grateful you use so much fresh mushroom in the dishes. It makes a real difference.
lines.style: Sincere and steady. A pause before 'grateful'—real thanks, not throwaway. Warm but grounded. The voice of someone who notices kindness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 最近、本気で、絶対、彼と、絶対、けんか、絶対、してないのよ、葵、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、平和
lines.en: Things have been so peaceful with him lately. No fights, just... quiet good.
lines.style: Soft and almost wondering. A small smile in the voice. Saying something tender that she doesn't often admit. Trailing slightly on 'quiet good.'

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵のサラダに、本気で、絶対、人参、絶対、新鮮なもの、絶対、使ってるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I really do love that you use the freshest carrots in your salads. That kind of care shows.
lines.style: Warm praise with genuine notice. Specific appreciation. Steady, kind tone. Not gushy—just real recognition of something done well.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵で、本気で、絶対、シーザーサラダ、絶対、レタス、絶対、たっぷり、本気で、入っていて、嬉しいわよ、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、絶対。
lines.en: And the Caesar salad—there's always so much lettuce. It makes me really happy, actually.
lines.style: Animated and genuine. Brightness on 'so much lettuce.' A little surprised at her own happiness about it. Warm and open.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、お土産、絶対、貰える、本気で、絶対、葵で、嬉しい
lines.en: I'm so glad you're getting souvenirs from me. That makes this even better.
lines.style: Warm, intimate close. A genuine smile audible. Soft emphasis on 'makes this even better.' The voice of someone who cares about being cared for in return.
